entities.summary: María Mayor Fernández de Cámara y Pita, known as María Pita, was a heroine in the defense of A Coruña, Galicia, against the English Armada attack, an English attack upon the Spanish mainland in 1589. She was born in Sigrás, a village in Cambre, Spain.
